hero.description: Home of the Mercer Chiefs — New Jersey's premier Tier II Junior (NCDC) and Tier I AAA youth hockey organization. We develop elite student-athletes with direct pathways to NCAA Division I & III college hockey.

tryouts.title: Join The Chiefs Tradition
tryouts.subtitle: Evaluations for Tier I AAA and Tier II AA teams are held at Ice Land Arena in Hamilton, NJ. Experience elite coaching, high-tempo practices, and premier league competition.

tier1.title: Tier 1 National Bound & Youth
tier1.desc: Full-season Tier 1 AAA program competing in the Tier 1 Hockey Federation (THF). Includes 3+ ice sessions per week, professional skating coach Oktay Armgan, video analysis, and off-ice conditioning.
tier1.arena: Ice Land Skating Center — Hamilton, NJ
tier1.equipment: Custom CCM Chiefs gloves, pants, bag, jerseys

tier2.title: Tier II Competitive & Development
tier2.desc: Competitive travel hockey competing in the Atlantic Hockey Federation (AHF). Focused on continuous player skill acquisition, positional awareness, team culture, and positive character building.

camps.title: Camps & Clinics
camps.subtitle: High-intensity development camps designed for elite skating, puck mastery, shooting mechanics, and game-situation awareness.

items.title: Chiefs Pre-Season Elite Camp
items.desc: Daily 3 hours on-ice instruction, dryland conditioning, tactical video review, and power skating with Chiefs coaching staff.

items.title: Terry Jarkowsky Goaltender Intensive
items.desc: Specialized goalie mechanics, edge control, rebound management, and high-tempo situational drills.

arena.title: Ice Land Skating Center
arena.desc: Located in Hamilton Township, NJ, Ice Land is the dedicated home ice of the Mercer Chiefs Junior and Youth hockey clubs. Featuring two NHL-regulation ice rinks, dedicated Chiefs team locker rooms, and comprehensive athlete training facilities.
arena.broadcastDesc: Never miss a moment of the action. Every Mercer Chiefs home and away game in the NCDC, USPHL Premier, and THF is broadcast in high-definition with live play-by-play, scoring overlays, and instant game replays.

program.title: Junior Hockey Defined
program.subtitle: Watch the official Mercer Chiefs commercial highlighting our tuition-free NCDC Tier II program, USPHL Premier development, and daily pathway to NCAA college hockey commitments.
program.sourceTitle: Mercer Chiefs NCDC & Premier Hockey Club
program.sourceLocation: Ice Land Skating Center • Hamilton Township, NJ

pillars.title: Tuition-Free NCDC Junior Hockey
pillars.desc: Top-tier junior hockey with zero player tuition fees, full equipment packages, dedicated coaching, and elite national showcase exposure.

pillars.title: Direct NCAA College Advancement
pillars.desc: Extensive NCAA Division I & Division III commitment network with regular scout attendance and personal advocacy from Head Coach Rob Broderick.

pillars.title: Dedicated Home Ice & Club Facilities
pillars.desc: Dedicated Junior team locker room suite, strength & dryland training area, video review room, and two regulation ice sheets at Ice Land in Hamilton, NJ.

pillars.title: Unified Ladder of Development
pillars.desc: Seamless player progression from Mite 8U through Tier I AAA Youth to USPHL Premier and NCDC Junior Hockey under one unified culture.

program.calloutText: Ready to take the ice for the 2026/27 campaign?

billetModal.title: Become a Mercer Chiefs Billet Family
billetModal.desc: Junior players travel from across North America and Europe to compete for the Chiefs NCDC and Premier squads. Billet families provide a welcoming home, supportive meals, and become lifelong members of our hockey family.
billetModal.perk1: VIP Passes to all Chiefs games

tryoutModal.title: Tryout Registration Portal
tryoutModal.desc: Register your player for upcoming Tier I AAA (THF) and Tier II (AHF) evaluations at Ice Land Arena.

branding.description: Dedicated to developing student-athletes through competitive Tier II tuition-free junior hockey and premier Tier 1 AAA youth competition in Hamilton, New Jersey.
